integrity: The full mathematical proof supplies all-order sufficiency and necessity; finite code checks provide supporting evidence only. The closest generic representation and action-copy bounds are credited. No independent mathematical audit was performed.
limitations: Two agents; finite nonempty worlds; every co-singleton neighborhood for both agents at every world; deterministic successor outcomes. The tables are constructive, not unique, and the result does not treat arbitrary actual-effectivity frames. Historical priority under equivalent symmetric array or quasigroup terminology has not been independently settled.
title: Optimal symmetric realization of co-singleton actual-effectivity frames
